name: page-header
summary: The top of a page or a section: its title, a line above that says where it sits, a sentence under it, and the page's actions.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The page's or section's title, a heading.

properties.name: eyebrow
properties.description: A short line above the title: what kind of page this is or where it sits.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A short sentence under the title.

properties.name: level
properties.description: 1 for a page's title, 2 for a section's.

properties.name: size
properties.description: md for an app page, lg for a landing or profile page.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The page's actions: beside the title where they fit, under it where they don't.

slots.name: media
slots.description: A picture above the title, at the header's full width.

slots.name: content
slots.description: More under the description, such as badges or a byline.

states.name: rest
states.description: The title in the theme's heading weight, the eyebrow in the primary colour.

accessibility.name: Its title, a heading at its level.
accessibility.apple: The title has the header trait and accessibilityHeading at its level; the actions are their own controls.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Group; the title is ControlType.Text with HeadingLevel 1 or 2.

props.title: Lemon orzo with peas
props.description: Bright, quick and made in one pot.

cases.person: A small blue Weeknight, a large title, a grey sentence, and a Cook button at the end of the title.

deviations: A breadcrumb slot; native navigation stacks show where a page sits.
